meta.title: Harness OS · Boot Sequence
meta.description: A monochrome Harness OS boot sequence with spoken access prompts, typewriter headlines, a real machine profile (computer name, user, time, IP), a zero-to-full circular radar with a radar-progress-synced needle, glitch scene transitions, a Chinese-then-English welcome voice, synthesized loading audio, and replay when the window is restored from the system tray.
